paragraphs.text: Layered oxide cathodes were cycled at 1C in the voltage window of 2.8-4.3 V for 200 cycles.
After 200 cycles, the discharge capacity retention was 84.3% for the doped sample and 71.5% for the undoped baseline.
XPS results suggest that surface oxygen loss may contribute to the capacity fade.
